title: How Much is a Grasshopper Worth?
summary: 27-second explainer Short: a grasshopper looks like a queen (orthogonal + diagonal lines) but must jump over a piece and land directly behind it; strong on a crowded board (x-ray forks, x-ray checkmates), weakens as pieces are traded, nearly useless in endgames.
rules: Grasshopper moves along queen lines but only by hopping over the first piece in that line, landing on the square immediately beyond it (capturing an enemy there).
No game is played in the video (explainer).
win_condition: N/A (explainer). For a playable mode: standard checkmate (inferred).
